universe: Export, import, check and clean up a universe.
universe export: Export this universe's database to one archive file.
universe import: Replace the local universe from an archive file.
universe level: Read what each universe level can launch.
universe level capacity: Read what each universe level can launch.
universe level capacity get: Show what each universe level can launch now, and why.
universe level-capacity: Read what each universe level can launch.
universe level-capacity get: Show what each universe level can launch now, and why.
universe prune: Preview or delete old disposable records.
universe retention: Read how long old records are kept.
universe retention get: Show how long old records are kept, and the cutoff.
universe validate: Check a universe archive before moving it.
